outgoing.name: Australia
outgoing.excerpt: Lemon myrtle (Backhousia citriodora) is a flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae, native to the semi-temperate rainforests of eastern Australia.

outgoing.name: Lemon
outgoing.excerpt: The common name reflects the strong sweet lemon smell of the crushed leaves.

outgoing.name: World War II
outgoing.excerpt: In World War II the leaves were actually used by the soft drink company Tarax to flavour lemonade.
